# cidaas_hosted_page (Resource)

The `cidaas_hosted_page` resource in the provider is used to define and manage single hosted pages within the Cidaas system for **cidaas v3.x** tenants.

> **Note for v4.x (Trustdesk) Tenants:** For cidaas v4.x, use **[`cidaas_hosted_page_group`](hosted_page_group.md)** instead.

Ensure that the below scopes are assigned to the client with the specified `client_id`:
- cidaas:hosted_pages_read
- cidaas:hosted_pages_write
- cidaas:hosted_pages_delete

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example configuration for cidaas_hosted_page on v3.x tenants:
resource "cidaas_hosted_page" "sample_hosted_page" {
  hosted_page_id = "login"
  content        = "<h1>Login</h1>"
  locale         = "en"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The HTML/CSS content of the hosted page.
- `hosted_page_id` (String) The ID of the hosted page (e.g., `login`, `register`, `password_forgot`).
- `locale` (String) The locale of the hosted page (e.g., `en`, `de`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The internal unique ID assigned by Cidaas.
